security_spec.violation_condition: When XiangShan RTL implements ACLIC but retains the old spec's CSR-based indirect access path (xaclicsourcecfg[k] at xiselect indices 0x1000-0x1100 via xireg2/xireg3, xacliciprio[k] at the same index range) AND/OR the ACLIC-specific eidelivery=0x20000000 delivery mode in the IMSIC CSR routing logic, while software follows the new MMIO-only APLIC direct-delivery spec (DM=0, setipnum/clripnum/setienum/clrienum by IID, sourcecfg with IE/IP at bits 31:30)
security_spec.summary: Spec eliminates CSR-based ACLIC indirect register access and ACLIC-specific delivery mode (eidelivery=0x20000000, domaincfg.DM=2) in favor of MMIO APLIC direct-delivery subset — stale CSR-to-MMIO mismatch causes undeliverable external interrupts across all privilege modes

findings.finding: miselect isIllegal gates all indices >= 0x100 as illegal. MISelectField maxValue=0xFF means the old ACLIC xaclicsourcecfg/xacliciprio indices at 0x1000-0x1100 are 16x beyond the reachable range. No CSR-based indirect access path to ACLIC sourcecfg/iprio registers exists.
findings.snippet:
val miselect = Module(new CSRModule("Miselect", new MISelectBundle) with HasISelectBundle {
  private val value = reg.ALL.asUInt
  inIMSICRange := value >= 0x70.U && value < 0x100.U
  isIllegal :=
    value < 0x30.U ||
    value >= 0x30.U && value < 0x40.U && value(0) === 1.U ||
    value >= 0x40.U && value < 0x70.U ||
    value >= 0x100.U
})

findings.finding: siselect isIllegal gates all indices >= 0x100 as illegal. SISelectField reserves 0x100-0xFFF explicitly. Even though maxValue=0xFFF could theoretically reach 0x1000-0x1100, the isIllegal combinational logic blocks everything >= 0x100 before WARL truncation applies.
findings.snippet:
val siselect = Module(new CSRModule("Siselect", new SISelectBundle) with HasISelectBundle {
  private val value = reg.ALL.asUInt
  inIMSICRange := value >= 0x70.U && value < 0x100.U
  isIllegal :=
    value < 0x30.U ||
    value >= 0x30.U && value < 0x40.U && value(0) === 1.U ||
    value >= 0x40.U && value < 0x70.U ||
    value >= 0x100.U
})

location.function_name: CSRIND indirect data registers mireg2-6, sireg2-6, vsireg2-6

findings.finding: All reserved indirect data registers (mireg2-6, sireg2-6, vsireg2-6) are ZeroFieldBundle hardwired to read zero. These would be the accessors for xaclicsourcecfg/xacliciprio under the old spec, but they hold no ACLIC state. No xireg2/xireg3 registers exist at xiselect indices 0x1000-0x1100.

The mireg/sireg read data Mux1H only maps priority registers (iprio0, iprio2, iprios[4..15]) at addresses 0x30-0x3F. No xaclicsourcecfg or xacliciprio entries exist in the Mux1H tree, confirming the indirect read path has no ACLIC semantics.

PMAConfigEntry at 0x20000000 is a generic executable memory PMA region, NOT the ACLIC eidelivery CSR. Verified: zero RTL matches for 'eidelivery', 'eidelivery', or ACLIC delivery mode encoding. The numerical coincidence with the old ACLIC eidelivery CSR address is harmless.
findings.snippet: PMAConfigEntry(0x20000000L, a = 1, x = true, w = true, r = true),

findings.finding: vsiselect is the most restricted select register: isIllegal for values < 0x70 or >= 0x100 (IMSIC-only range). No virtual-machine path to ACLIC indices exists.
findings.snippet:
val vsiselect = Module(new CSRModule("VSiselect", new VSISelectBundle) with HasISelectBundle {
  private val value = reg.ALL.asUInt
  inIMSICRange := value >= 0x70.U && value < 0x100.U
  isIllegal :=
    value < 0x70.U ||
    value >= 0x100.U
})

findings.finding: MISelectField WARL bounds are explicitly 0-0xFF with reserved ranges 0x00-0x2F and 0x40-0x6F. WARL conversion of an out-of-range write (e.g., 0x1000) maps to a legal value within 0-0xFF, not to any ACLIC index. No WARL bypass exists.
findings.snippet:
object MISelectField extends ISelectField(
  maxValue = 0xFF,
  reserved = Seq(
    Range.inclusive(0x00, 0x2F),
    Range.inclusive(0x40, 0x6F),
  ),
)

findings.finding: SISelectField WARL bounds 0-0xFFF with 0x100-0xFFF explicitly reserved. The reserved range covers the ACLIC index space (0x1000-0x1100 is beyond even the maxValue), ensuring WARL conversion prevents access.
findings.snippet:
object SISelectField extends ISelectField(
  maxValue = 0xFFF,
  reserved = Seq(
    Range.inclusive(0x000, 0x02F),
    Range.inclusive(0x040, 0x06F),
    Range.inclusive(0x100, 0xFFF),
  ),
)
